q: The historical method of research is concerned with:
options: studying past events using records and documents
exp: It involves critical examination of sources.

q: The National Educational Technology Forum (NETF) was proposed in the NEP 2020 to:
options: provide a platform for free exchange of ideas on the use of technology for learning
exp: NETF is an autonomous body for technology in education.

q: PARAKH, proposed in NEP 2020, is:
options: a national assessment centre setting norms for student assessment
exp: PARAKH stands for Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development.

q: Gender-sensitive teaching means that the teacher:
options: prefers boys in computer lab work
gives equal opportunity and respect to boys and girls
exp: It avoids bias and promotes equity.

q: Worked examples in teaching programming are effective because they:
options: show the complete solution process for learners to study
exp: Studying solved examples helps beginners learn problem-solving patterns.

q: Gagne's nine events of instruction begin with:
options: gaining the attention of the learners
exp: Gaining attention is the first event, followed by informing the learner of the objective.

q: Which of the following is the best description of 'panel discussion'?
options: One person reads a paper without interaction
A small group of experts discusses a topic informally in front of an audience
The teacher dictates questions to the class
exp: In a panel discussion the experts talk with one another under a moderator while the audience listens.

q: An interactive whiteboard (smart board) is useful mainly because it:
options: replaces the need for lesson planning
allows the teacher to write, display digital content and save the lesson
exp: It combines a touch-sensitive board with a computer and projector.

q: Fluency in questioning means:
options: asking questions smoothly and in a logical sequence
asking the same question again and again
exp: Fluency means the ability to frame and ask questions without hesitation.

q: The annual plan of a teacher is prepared:
options: at the beginning of the academic session
exp: It distributes the syllabus over the year.

q: Which of the following is the correct sequence in curriculum development?
options: Needs assessment, objectives, content selection, learning experiences, evaluation
exp: Development begins by assessing needs and defining objectives and ends with evaluation.

q: What should be the first step in the evaluation process?
exp: Evaluation is meaningless without clearly stated objectives.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: A well-designed blueprint helps mainly to improve:
exp: It ensures that the test samples all the objectives and content areas.

q: The parallel-forms method estimates reliability by:
options: giving two equivalent forms of the test to the same group
exp: The correlation between two equivalent forms indicates reliability.

q: Which of the following is a proper principle of remedial teaching?
options: It should be a repetition of the same method that failed
It should be individualised and encouraging
It should be done only by the principal
exp: Different, supportive strategies suit the learner's difficulty.

q: Research that focuses on testing theories without immediate application is called:
exp: Basic research aims at knowledge, not an immediate solution.

q: Virtual labs help students by:
options: allowing them to perform simulated experiments online
exp: They give access to experiments where physical labs are limited.

q: Which of the following is a feature of NEP 2020 regarding board examinations?
options: Making them low-stakes with an emphasis on testing core concepts and skills
Conducting them only once at the end of Grade 12 with memory focus
exp: Board exams are to be redesigned to reduce pressure and test competencies.

q: A teacher who is always punctual and honest is serving as:
exp: Students learn values by observing their teacher's conduct.

q: Project-based learning in CS, such as building a small library management program, helps to:
options: integrate concepts and develop real-world skills
exp: Projects apply many concepts together.

q: Constructivism holds that:
options: knowledge is poured into passive learners
learning is only memorisation of facts
learners actively build their own knowledge from experience
the teacher is the sole source of knowledge
exp: Constructivists see learning as active construction of meaning on the basis of prior knowledge.

q: A teacher narrates how a king solved problems through logical steps to introduce algorithms to young learners. This method is:
exp: Narrating a story to convey a concept or value is the storytelling method.

q: A working model of a human heart is an example of:
exp: Models are 3-D representations that show structure and function.

q:
Assertion (A): Microteaching reduces the complexity of normal teaching.
Reason (R): It limits the class size, time and number of skills practised.
Choose the correct option.
options: A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true, and R explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is false but R is true
exp: Reducing size, time and skills makes the teaching situation simpler.

q:
Arrange the following in the usual order in a lesson plan:
P. Presentation of content
Q. Statement of objectives
R. Evaluation
S. Introduction
exp: Objectives are fixed first, followed by introduction, presentation and evaluation.

q: The national framework for the school curriculum in India is prepared by:
exp: NCERT develops the National Curriculum Framework.

q: Peer assessment means:
options: students assess each other's work using given criteria
exp: Peer assessment develops critical judgement and responsibility.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: A teacher-made test is different from a standardised test because the teacher-made test:
options: is prepared by the teacher for a specific class and lacks established norms
is administered to the whole country
exp: Standardised tests have tried-out items, norms and uniform procedures.

q: Face validity means that:
options: the test appears on the surface to measure what it should
exp: It is a superficial judgement of appropriateness.

q: Programmed instruction, based on Skinner's ideas, presents:
options: material in small steps with immediate feedback
exp: Small steps, active response and immediate reinforcement are its features.

q: Informed consent in educational research means that participants:
options: agree to take part after knowing the purpose and nature of the study
exp: It is a basic ethical principle.

q: Presenting someone else's work as your own without acknowledgement is called:
exp: Plagiarism is a violation of academic ethics.

q: NEP 2020 recommends introducing coding to students from:
exp: A fun course on coding starts in Grade 6 as part of computational thinking.

q: The preventive approach to classroom management emphasises:
options: planning routines and activities to avoid discipline problems
exp: Good planning and engagement reduce misbehaviour.

q: Which of the following is a safe lab practice that a CS teacher should teach?
options: Shutting down systems properly and not eating near computers
Removing the power cable to shut down
exp: Proper handling protects equipment and data.

q:
Statement I: Teaching is always intentional and planned.
Statement II: Learning can occur incidentally, without any teacher.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both Statements I and II are true
Both Statements I and II are false
exp: Teaching aims at specific outcomes, while learning can also happen informally and by chance.

q: In the jigsaw technique of cooperative learning:
options: each group member becomes an expert on one part and teaches it to the others
all students read the entire text alone
the teacher teaches each part in turn
students compete against each other for marks
exp: Jigsaw makes learners interdependent as each one is responsible for teaching a part.

q: Which of the following aids requires no electricity?
exp: A flip chart is paper-based and used manually.
